svg.aria-label: Adoption mode check across osf commands
svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Adoption mode check across osf commands
svg.desc: Every command that reads the repository's own osf.toml now reaches one parse step, config::repo_document, which checks adoption_mode. The layered load and the gate share its parser; the risk and review-context readers now propagate its errors instead of defaulting.
